section: Awards and honours - national civilian awards, international prizes, film and literary awards

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Nobel Prize in Physics, 2025:
1. John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis were the laureates.
2. The prize recognised macroscopic quantum tunnelling in electrical circuits.
3. The award was given for the discovery of regulatory T-cells.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis received the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics for macroscopic quantum tunnelling in electrical circuits. Regulatory T-cells relate to the Nobel Prize in Medicine, not Physics.
accepted.tq: Split the options by matching each scientific work with its correct Nobel discipline.

accepted.s: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry, 2025 was awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi for work relating to:
o: Macroscopic quantum tunnelling in electrical circuits
accepted.x: Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi were recognised for their work on metal-organic frameworks, commonly abbreviated as MOFs.
accepted.tq: Use the laureate–discipline–recognised work association.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Nobel Prize in Medicine, 2025)
a. Shimon Sakaguchi
b. Mary Brunkow
c. Fred Ramsdell

List-II (Area of recognition)
i. Metal-organic frameworks
ii. Regulatory T-cells and peripheral immune tolerance
iii. Macroscopic quantum tunnelling

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell jointly received the 2025 Nobel Prize in Medicine for work on regulatory T-cells and peripheral immune tolerance.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and identify the common recognised work of all three laureates.

accepted.s: László Krasznahorkai, who received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2025, is associated with which pair of works?
o: Satantango and The Melancholy of Resistance
One Hundred Years of Solitude and Love in the Time of Cholera
The Old Man and the Sea and For Whom the Bell Tolls
accepted.x: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature laureate László Krasznahorkai of Hungary is associated with Satantango and The Melancholy of Resistance.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the laureate by linking the author with the works specifically associated with the award.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Nobel Peace Prize, 2025, consider the following statements:
1. María Corina Machado of Venezuela was the laureate.
2. The award recognised her democracy movement.
3. She gave the medal to Donald Trump in January 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: María Corina Machado of Venezuela received the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize for the democracy movement and gave the medal to Donald Trump in January 2026.
accepted.tq: Check the laureate, the cause and the subsequent event as separate components of the statement.

accepted.s: Which of the following combinations correctly represents the Nobel Prize in Economics, 2025 and the recognised contribution?
o: Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt — innovation-driven growth
John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis — innovation-driven growth
Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi — regulatory T-cells
Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell — metal-organic frameworks
accepted.x: Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt received the 2025 Nobel Prize in Economics for work on innovation-driven growth.
accepted.tq: Use the discipline and contribution together to reject swapped laureate groups.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about selected Nobel laureates:
1. Jon Fosse received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2023.
2. Har Gobind Khorana was the first Indian-origin Nobel laureate in Medicine.
3. V. Ramakrishnan received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2009 for work on ribosome structure.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Jon Fosse was the 2023 Literature laureate; Har Gobind Khorana was the first Indian-origin Medicine laureate; and V. Ramakrishnan won Chemistry in 2009 for work on ribosome structure.
accepted.tq: Treat each year–laureate–discipline combination as an independent statement.

accepted.s: Who won the International Booker Prize in 2026 for the novel Taiwan Travelogue?
o: Jon Fosse, translated by Banu Mushtaq
Yáng Shuāng-zǐ, translated by Lin King
Banu Mushtaq, translated by Deepa Bhasthi
László Krasznahorkai, translated by Lin King
accepted.x: Taiwan Travelogue by Yáng Shuāng-zǐ, translated by Lin King, won the International Booker Prize in 2026. It was the first Mandarin novel to win the prize.
accepted.tq: Separate the original author from the translator and identify the language distinction.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly distinguishes the International Booker Prize winners mentioned for 2025 and 2026?
o: Heart Lamp won in 2025, while Taiwan Travelogue won in 2026.
Taiwan Travelogue won in 2025, while Heart Lamp won in 2026.
Both prizes were won by Mandarin novels.
Both prizes were won by Kannada novels.
accepted.x: Banu Mushtaq’s Kannada work Heart Lamp won the International Booker Prize in 2025, while Yáng Shuāng-zǐ’s Mandarin novel Taiwan Travelogue won in 2026.
accepted.tq: Compare the adjacent years and identify the reversed year–title pairing.

accepted.s: The 68th Ramon Magsaysay Award, held in 2026, included which of the following group of awardees?
o: Educate Girls, Tommy Koh and Banu Mushtaq
Tommy Koh, Educate Girls and Lin King
Runa Khan, María Corina Machado and Bo Kyi
Tommy Koh, Runa Khan and Bo Kyi
accepted.x: The 68th Ramon Magsaysay Award in 2026 was given to Tommy Koh of Singapore, Runa Khan of Bangladesh and Bo Kyi of Myanmar.
accepted.tq: Match each awardee with the correct award year and award edition.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Ramon Magsaysay Award is correct?
1. Educate Girls was the first Indian organisation to win the award in 2025.
2. Tommy Koh was from Singapore.
3. Runa Khan was from Bangladesh and Bo Kyi was from Myanmar.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Educate Girls became the first Indian organisation to win the award in 2025, while the 2026 awardees included Tommy Koh of Singapore, Runa Khan of Bangladesh and Bo Kyi of Myanmar.
accepted.tq: Verify the organisation, nationality and award-year details separately.

accepted.s: Who became the first Indian-origin winner of the Wolf Prize in Physics in 2026?
accepted.x: Jainendra K. Jain became the first Indian-origin winner of the Wolf Prize in Physics in 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the distinction between Nobel laureates and the separately mentioned Wolf Prize laureate.

accepted.s: The absence of a Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2025 was notable because it was:
accepted.x: No Khel Ratna was given in 2025, and this was only the third such occurrence since the award began in 1991.
accepted.tq: Pay attention to the frequency qualifier rather than only the award name.

accepted.s: National Sports Awards are normally presented on which occasion and date?
accepted.x: National Sports Awards are normally presented on National Sports Day, observed on 29 August.
accepted.tq: Link the award ceremony with the commemorative day and its exact date.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the stated categories of the National Sports Awards?
o: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar for every individual athlete
accepted.x: The stated categories are the Khel Ratna, Arjuna, Dronacharya and Dhyan Chand Awards for lifetime achievement. The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar is an award category but is not described as being for every individual athlete.
accepted.tq: Find the option that changes the defined award category into an overbroad description.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding National Sports Awards:

List-I (Award)
a. Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna
b. Arjuna Award
c. Dronacharya Award

List-II (Year instituted)
i. 1961
ii. 1985
iii. 1991–92

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Khel Ratna was instituted in 1991–92, the Arjuna Award in 1961 and the Dronacharya Award in 1985.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive institution years and eliminate codes with a swapped sequence.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with the cash component stated for the award?
o: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna — ₹15 lakh
accepted.x: The Arjuna Award (Lifetime), instituted in 2024, carries ₹15 lakh. The Khel Ratna carries ₹25 lakh and the regular Arjuna Award carries ₹15 lakh; no cash amount is stated here for the Dronacharya Award.
accepted.tq: Compare award names with their cash amounts and detect the swapped figures.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:
1. It was formerly known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
2. It was instituted in 1991–92.
3. Its stated cash component is ₹25 lakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The award was formerly called the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, was instituted in 1991–92 and carries ₹25 lakh according to the stated details.
accepted.tq: Combine the former name, institution year and monetary value without confusing it with the Arjuna Award.

accepted.s: The Arjuna (Lifetime) Award was instituted in which year?
accepted.x: The Arjuna (Lifetime) Award was instituted in 2024 and carries a stated cash component of ₹15 lakh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the lifetime variant from the original Arjuna Award by its institution year.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the Dronacharya Award is correct?
1. It is intended for coaches.
2. It was instituted in 1985.
3. It is a lifetime award for sportspersons rather than an award for coaches.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Dronacharya Award is for coaches and was instituted in 1985. Statement 3 is false because it incorrectly describes the award as a lifetime award for sportspersons.
accepted.tq: Reject the swapped recipient description by asking who the award is intended for.

accepted.s: The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award, instituted in 1993, is ranked equal to which award?
o: Dhyan Chand Award for lifetime achievement
accepted.x: The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award was instituted in 1993 and ranks equal to the Arjuna Award.
accepted.tq: Use the equivalence relationship rather than confusing the award with the similarly named sports awards.
